correctness.rationale: Established operator-tree bijection: black row is minus the sum of its subtree, white row is the sum of child subtrees; the subtree vectors are unitriangular. After pivoting black coordinates, white rows have disjoint nonzero supports exactly for white vertices with white children. Species count yields two coupled functional equations and exact coefficients. Uniform Cayley-tree Prufer degrees and adjacent-pair bound prove the expectation and variance O(n). Independently enumerated Rota-Baxter matrices in characteristics two and three for n<=4, trees for n<=5, and formal-series coefficients/means match.
